diagnosis: Male breast with ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS)
legend: Breast cores show expanded ducts filled with a monotonous cribriform epithelial proliferation punctuated by relatively well-defined spaces that sometimes contain calcifications.  The abnormal epithelial population shows a solidified papillary configuration within a dilated duct.

diagnosis: Male breast with ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS): CK14 staining
legend: Immunohistochemistry for ER shows diffuse nuclear reactivity while that for the high molecular weight keratin CK14 displays diminished staining, supporting a neoplastic process and corroborating the diagnosis of low grade ductal carcinoma in situ.
